english.meaning: written-style particle read liu5; after 不 or 唔 it means cannot be done or cannot be avoided
english.note: Seen in 罪不了, a sin that cannot be forgiven. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Going completely red isn’t some unforgivable sin, is it?
exampleSentences.traditional: 全部紅又唔係乜嘢罪不了嘅事，係唔係？
